name: @lostgradient/velveteen

scripts.test:types: bun tests/types/check-types.ts && bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts src/types && bun tests/types/generated/check-generated-types.ts && bun tests/remote/check-types.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json && svelte-check --workspace tests/fixtures/candidate --tsconfig ../../../tsconfig.json --config ../../../svelte-check.config.ts --fail-on-warnings && svelte-check --workspace src --tsconfig ../tsconfig.json --config ../svelte-check.config.ts --fail-on-warnings
scripts.prepare:reference: bun tests/reference/prepare-upstream.ts && bun tests/reference/install.ts && bun tests/reference/check-identity.ts
scripts.test:first-batch: bun run test:native && bun run test:inventory && bun run test:harness && bun run test:types && bun run audit:dependencies && bun run test:compiler && bun run test:development && bun run test:production && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:reference
scripts.test: bun ../../scripts/bun-test-junit.ts --path-ignore-patterns='**/*.integration.test.ts' bun-primitives.test.ts src/compiler/compiler.test.ts src/data src/types src/routing/route-order.test.ts src/routing/synchronize.test.ts
scripts.test:batch-c: bun run test:routing && bun run test:first-batch
scripts.test:build: bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts tests/build/native-bundler.test.ts tests/build/native-serving.test.ts tests/build/browser-boundary.test.ts tests/build/graph.test.ts tests/build/server-assets.test.ts tests/build/build.test.ts tests/build/publication.test.ts tests/build/serving.test.ts
scripts.test:batch-d: bun run test:build && bun run test:package && bun run test:batch-c && bun run audit:production
scripts.test:security: bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts tests/server/security.test.ts tests/server/internal-fetch.test.ts src/data/codec.test.ts src/data/fetch.test.ts src/data/transport.test.ts src/server/responses.test.ts tests/server/mutations.test.ts tests/remote/remote.test.ts tests/build/build-errors.test.ts
scripts.test:batch-ef: bun ../../scripts/bun-test.ts src/data && bun run test:server && bun run test:browser && bun run test:runtime-lifecycle && bun run test:runtime-controls && bun run test:conformance -- --mode=development && bun run test:conformance -- --mode=production && bun run test:batch-d
scripts.test:batch-gh: bun run test:actions && bun run test:remote && bun run test:prerender && bun run test:build-errors && bun run test:security && bun run test:batch-ef
scripts.test:batch-i: bun run test:package-consumer && bun run test:batch-gh
scripts.test:navigation: bun run test:navigation-addresses && bun run test:navigation-lifecycle && bun run test:navigation-recovery
scripts.test:batch-j: bun run test:navigation && bun run test:batch-i

description: Bun-native Svelte compiler and application framework.
